title: 유한책임신탁등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Registration of Trustee, etc.) When registering a trustee, trust property administrator, or liquidating trustee, the name, address, and resident registration number shall be recorded; in the case of a corporation, its trade name or name, location of its principal office or main office, and corporate registration number shall be recorded. In the case of an overseas Korean national or foreigner who has no resident registration number, his or her alien registration number, domestic residence report number, or date of birth shall be recorded in lieu of the resident registration number. <Amended on November 29, 2024>
